complete-source-unit:formula-output/bran.fix: Add a principal derived rule whose formula implements the branch and whose source or formula proof cites the branch, or precisely defer the branch.

complete-source-unit:formula-output/bran.title: Explicit source computation has no principal output
complete-source-unit:formula-output/bran.why: A computation stated only as parameters cannot be executed or tested; consumers of the module get no computed amount.

complete-source-unit:numeric-recall/valu.fix: Add a parameter (or bind the value in an existing one) for the missing value, grounded in the source text. `module.summary` does not count.
complete-source-unit:numeric-recall/valu.requires: Every numeric value in the authoritative source text is represented by a named scalar (a parameter or a named constant) in the module.
complete-source-unit:numeric-recall/valu.title: Source numeric value has no named scalar
complete-source-unit:numeric-recall/valu.why: A number the source states but the module does not name is either dropped law or hidden inside a formula, where it cannot be grounded or updated.

complete-source-unit:source-explicit-con.fix: Declare each source-stated fact as its own document-root `inputs` entry (a sibling of `module` and `rules`) or canonical import, combine them in a derived Judgment with formula proof, and test each gate.
complete-source-unit:source-explicit-con.requires: Each factual gate that the formula's own source clause states is a distinct local input or canonical import, combined in a source-proved derived Judgment.
complete-source-unit:source-explicit-con.title: Source-stated conjunctive gates collapsed into too few inputs
complete-source-unit:source-explicit-con.why: An aggregate input that stands for several source-stated facts hides the conditions from tests and from callers, so a wrong answer on one gate cannot be seen.

complete-source-unit:tests/boundary-unex.fix: Add cases at each listed boundary value (and just across it) that assert the affected principal output.
complete-source-unit:tests/boundary-unex.requires: Every source-stated boundary value is exercised by a companion case.
complete-source-unit:tests/boundary-unex.title: Source-stated boundary input is not exercised
complete-source-unit:tests/boundary-unex.why: Companion tests are the executed evidence that the encoding behaves as the source says. A source-stated output, branch, boundary, exception or rounding rule without a test can be wrong without any gate noticing.

complete-source-unit:tests/exception-pai.fix: For each listed condition, add two same-period cases that differ only in its controlling input: one where it applies and one where it blocks.
complete-source-unit:tests/exception-pai.requires: Each source-stated exception or applicability condition has a same-period pair of cases that differ in exactly the controlling input and assert the affected principal output.
complete-source-unit:tests/exception-pai.title: Source exception or condition has no positive/blocking case pair
complete-source-unit:tests/exception-pai.why: Companion tests are the executed evidence that the encoding behaves as the source says. A source-stated output, branch, boundary, exception or rounding rule without a test can be wrong without any gate noticing.

complete-source-unit:tests/formula-branc.fix: Add a companion case whose inputs select the named branch and whose asserted output depends on the branch's computation, in a period the branch's formula version covers.
complete-source-unit:tests/formula-branc.requires: Each source formula branch has distinct executed test evidence that reaches the branch's computation.
complete-source-unit:tests/formula-branc.title: Formula branch has no executed companion evidence
complete-source-unit:tests/formula-branc.why: Companion tests are the executed evidence that the encoding behaves as the source says. A source-stated output, branch, boundary, exception or rounding rule without a test can be wrong without any gate noticing.

issues.message: [complete-source-unit:tests] Source-stated exceptions or applicability conditions require paired positive/blocking cases that assert the affected principal output and toggle its controlling formula selector. Each listed condition needs its own same-period case pair differing in exactly that one input; missing: us-ks/manual/dcf/keesm/2026-01-01/keesm13360 [source unit] [change]: `Interest and Dividends Interest and dividends - If interest and dividends are received irregularly, are unpredictable and are less than $30 in a quarter, they are exempt.`; us-ks/manual/dcf/keesm/2026-01-01/keesm13360 [source unit] [exclude]: `All payments are exempt except on-the-job training payments received by persons age 19 or over, or received by persons under the age of 19 who are not under the parental control of another household member;`; us-ks/manual/dcf/keesm/2026-01-01/keesm13360 [source unit] [change]: `Workforce Investment Opportunity Act (WIOA) - Income received from the Workforce Investment Opportunity Act of 1998 (WIOA) is exempt as income ... ogram payments and paid work experience received by persons 19 or older.`. The evaluator recognized 2 directional formula-toggle witnesses from 1 distinct case pairs, but these do not cover every listed source condition. Check affected rule/path, source-selector relevance, active orientation, required effect, and distinct-condition witness allocation before adding cases. Recognized test pairs alone do not establish source coverage.
